content_sections.heading: CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details (Discipline-wise)
content_sections.text: 182 HC/GD (Male 150, Female 32) 339 CT/GD (Male 258, Female 81) 521 Grand Total Note: Each discipline above is further broken down by specific event/weight category and by Male/Female, HC/GD and CT/GD in the official notification (e.g., Athletics lists 100m, 400m, Long Jump, Javelin Throw, etc. separately; Boxing, Judo, Karate, Taekwondo, Weightlifting and Wrestling are broken down by weight category). This level of granular, event-wise vacancy detail runs to several pages in the source document – refer to the official notification on rect.crpf.gov.in for the exact event/weight-wise numbers. Vacancies are tentative and may increase or decrease without notice; any change will be intimated on the CRPF recruitment website.

content_sections.heading: CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates who do not possess the prescribed educational qualification as on 11 November 2026 are not eligible to apply. Educational and sports qualification certificates other than from a Central/State Board must be accompanied by a Government notification declaring the equivalence of that qualification for Central Government service. Represented the country in a recognized International Competition/Meet, with clearance from the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. Represented a State/UT in the National Games/Championship organized by a National Sports Federation recognized by the Department of Sports, or in National Games organized by the Indian Olympic Association, with a medal or position up to 3rd place. Secured 1st or 2nd position in an individual event in Inter-University Tournaments (for team events, the team must have reached the finals) conducted by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU)/Inter University Sports Board. Won Gold or Silver medal in an individual/team event at Junior National level Games/Championship/Meet organized by a recognized National Sports Federation. Represented a State in Senior/Junior National level Games/Championships organized by a recognized National Sports Federation. Represented a State School Team in National Sports/Games for Schools conducted by the All-India School Games Federation of India (SGFI), with a medal or position up to 3rd place. Represented a State/UT in Khelo India University Games/Khelo India Youth Games/Khelo India Winter Games, with a medal or position up to 3rd place. Represented their University in Inter-University Tournaments conducted by the Inter-University Sports Boards, in any sport/game.

content_sections.heading: CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection proceeds through Identity Check, Documentation, Physical Standard Test (PST), Sports Trial Test, and Detailed/Review Medical Examination, in sequence. All candidates undergo document verification, producing original documents/certificates relating to age, education, sports achievement, domicile and category. Candidates unable to produce the prescribed originals are eliminated at this stage; those qualified proceed to the PST. Marks are awarded for the single highest medal/position achieved during the eligible window (30 September 2024 to 30 September 2026); if a candidate has more than one medal, only the highest-scoring one counts. Sample marking tiers: Height/chest relaxations are available for several categories, including Scheduled Tribes (162.5/150 cm), ST candidates of North-Eastern States (157/147.5 cm), ST candidates of Left-Wing Extremism-affected districts (160/147.5 cm), Garhwalis/Kumaonis/Dogras/Marathas and candidates from Assam, Himachal Pradesh, J&K and Ladakh (165/155 cm), candidates from the North-Eastern States of Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura (162.5/152.5 cm), and candidates from the Gorkha Territorial Administration area of Darjeeling district (157/152.5 cm), with corresponding chest relaxations for male candidates in several of these categories. Candidates who qualify the PST undergo the Sports Trial Test, conducted by a Board of Officers. This test is purely qualifying (pass/fail) – no marks are awarded, and total marks for the merit list come only from the achievement marking scheme above. Candidates may be subjected to a Dope Test on the day of the trial; no appeal for re-conduct of the trial test is entertained. Conducted per the Uniform Guidelines for Recruitment Medical Examination for GOs and NGOs in CAPFs and AR (MHA U.O. No. A.VI-1/2014-Rectt(SSB) dated 20.05.2015 and MHA OM No. E.32012/ADG(Med)/DME/RME/DA-1/2020(Part file)/1166 dated 31.05.2021, as amended). Minimum distance vision required is 6/6 and 6/9 in both eyes without correction; colour-blind candidates are not eligible; candidates must not have knock knee, flat foot, varicose veins or squint. Tattoos are restricted in content (secular/religious symbols only, as per Indian Army norms), location (left forearm inner aspect or dorsum of hands only) and size (less than ¼ of that body part). Candidates declared unfit in DME may undergo RME. Where marks are comparable, preference follows this order: (a) International representation with Department of Sports clearance; (b) Senior/Junior National Championship representation with a medal (Senior preferred over Junior); (c) Inter-University/Khelo India University Games medal; (d) Khelo India Youth/Winter Games medal; (e) School National Games medal; (f) participation at levels (b)–(e) without a medal, in the same order.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit rect.crpf.gov.in and read the instructions carefully before filling the application. Create your profile and upload a copy of the certificate/document for your sports discipline, in support of your highest medal/position or highest level of participation, before applying – applications without this upload will be rejected during scrutiny. Fill the online application form and pay the application fee (where applicable) through the website only. Submit the application before 11 November 2026, 23:59 hrs . Use the correction window (12–14 November 2026) if you need to modify your submitted application. Important: The application must be submitted ONLINE only; no offline application is accepted, and candidature of anyone submitting offline will be summarily rejected. Candidates serving in Government/Semi-Government departments must submit their application through their employer along with a No Objection Certificate (as per Annexure-A format) – applications without an NOC will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required (Original, at Document Verification)
content_sections.text: Educational certificates, Sports certificates, Domicile and Caste certificates, etc. Matriculation/10th class certificate, for verification of Date of Birth OBC (NCL) Certificate (Annexure-F), SC/ST Certificate (Annexure-G), or EWS Certificate valid for 2026-27 (Annexure-H), as applicable – certificates in any other format are not accepted Undertaking for OBC (NCL) reservation claim, as per Annexure-F No Objection Certificate (Annexure-B), for candidates serving in Government service, produced at the time of physical document verification Certificate for claiming height/chest relaxation (Annexure-I), if applicable Four latest passport-size photographs, matching the one submitted with the application form

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Application Fee: Male candidates belonging to UR/OBC/EWS pay Rs. 100/- through the recruitment website; the fee is exempted for all female candidates and for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen candidates. The fee is neither refunded nor adjusted against any other recruitment process, under any circumstances. Selected candidates must submit a bond to serve the Force for a minimum of 3 years (or a specific period as prescribed), backed by an undertaking bond of Rs. 1,00,000/-, to promote sports in the Force, before they can resign for better employment elsewhere or on any other ground. Posts carry All India service liability; selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India or abroad, and will be governed by the CRPF Act 1949 and Rules 1955. CRPF reserves the right to modify, cancel, postpone, or reschedule any stage of the recruitment process, and to change the sequence of the recruitment procedure, without assigning any reason. Submitting fabricated documents, or documents that have been tampered with, will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, including at the time of document verification or later. The Board of Officers may also recommend cases of Outstanding Sportspersons who show excellent trial performance but require some relaxation in height/chest/weight for their sport, subject to approval by the Ministry of Home Affairs.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has CRPF advertised under the Sports Quota?
faq.answer: 521 posts – 182 Head Constable (GD) and 339 Constable (GD) – across 22 sports disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: 11 November 2026, till 23:59 hrs; the application window opened on 12 October 2026 at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Meritorious male/female sportspersons who have represented the country, a State/UT, their University, or their School in recognized competitions at specified levels, within the last two years, and who meet the age and educational qualification for the post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: 18 to 23 years as on the cut-off date of 1 August 2026, with age relaxation of 5 to 13 years depending on category and Ex-Servicemen status.

faq.question: Q5. Is there a written exam?
faq.answer: No. Selection is based on a merit list built from sports achievement marks, followed by a Physical Standard Test, a qualifying Sports Trial Test, and a medical examination – there is no written test or interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs. 100/- for male UR/OBC/EWS candidates; exempted for all female candidates and for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay scale?
faq.answer: Head Constable (GD): Level 4, Rs. 25,500–81,100. Constable (GD): Level 3, Rs. 21,700–69,100.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a service bond?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates must execute a Rs. 1,00,000/- bond committing to serve the Force for at least 3 years.
